exegra.doc: Schema version of the specification format.

vocabulary.doc: Model-defined extensions of categories, relationship kinds and properties.

logical.label: Logical module
logical.description: A logical unit of responsibility with no declared runtime of its own.

computational.label: Computational service
computational.description: An executing process or service that performs computation.

storage.label: Data store
storage.description: A component whose responsibility is durable or shared state.

external.label: External system
external.description: A system outside the control of the specified system.

infrastructure.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Platform, transport, tooling or operational substrate.

transport.label: Message transport
transport.description: An asynchronous channel carrying messages between components.

depends-on.label: Depends on
depends-on.description: The source requires the target to fulfil its responsibilities.

calls.label: Calls
calls.description: The source synchronously invokes an operation of the target.

data-flow.label: Data flow
data-flow.description: Data moves from source to target. Says nothing about who initiates.

publishes.label: Publishes
publishes.description: The source asynchronously emits messages to the target channel.

subscribes.label: Subscribes
subscribes.description: The source consumes messages from the target channel.

reads.label: Reads
reads.description: The source reads state held by the target.

writes.label: Writes
writes.description: The source mutates state held by the target.

observes.label: Observes
observes.description: The source collects telemetry about the target.

system.label: System
system.doc: The top-level specification and its metadata.

illustrative.label: Illustrative
illustrative.doc: True when the whole system is an example and not a description of real software.

component.label: Component
component.doc: A logical, computational, storage, client, external or infrastructure entity. kind 'subsystem' marks a component that contains other components.

kind.label: Kind
kind.doc: Defaults to component. Only a subsystem may be the parent of other components.

trustZone.label: Trust zone
trustZone.doc: Name of the trust boundary this component lives inside.

port.label: Port
port.doc: An explicitly declared interaction surface of a component.

relationship.label: Relationship
relationship.doc: A typed, directed connection between components or ports.

contract.label: Contract
contract.doc: Inputs, outputs, preconditions, postconditions, error conditions and obligations of an interaction.

event.label: Event
event.doc: An occurrence that can trigger transitions.

behavior.label: Behavior
behavior.doc: A state machine describing how one component reacts to events.

state.label: State
state.doc: A defined configuration within a behavior.

transition.label: Transition
transition.doc: A declared change between states with a trigger, guard and effects.

faultOnly.label: Fault only
faultOnly.doc: The transition exists only when a fault of kind enable-transition activates it.

fault.label: Fault
fault.doc: A declared deviation that a scenario run can inject.

occurrence.label: Occurrence
occurrence.doc: 1-based occurrence of the event to affect. Omitted means every occurrence.

realises.label: Realises failure mode
realises.doc: The failure mode this injection is an instance of. Not read by the simulation engine.

environment.label: Environment
environment.doc: What a deployment target guarantees: clock skew, message behavior, storage durability, consistency, zones and regions. Each guarantee names its source.

source.label: Source
source.doc: The entity that justifies the value: a requirement or other claim, an assumption, an evidence entity, or an entity of any kind the specification declares. Required; a missing source is a validation error.

failureMode.label: Failure mode
failureMode.doc: One way a component, a relationship or an environment can fail, with a sourced rate and duration.

scope.label: Scope
scope.doc: How much fails together: one instance up to a whole provider.

rate.label: Rate
rate.doc: How often it happens. Required, with a source; a missing rate or rate source is a validation error.

source.label: Source
source.doc: The entity that justifies the value: a requirement or other claim, an assumption, an evidence entity, or an entity of any kind the specification declares. Required; a missing source is a validation error.

duration.label: Duration
duration.doc: How long it lasts. With a duration, a source is required.

source.label: Source
source.doc: The entity that justifies the value: a requirement or other claim, an assumption, an evidence entity, or an entity of any kind the specification declares. Required; a missing source is a validation error.

faultModel.label: Fault model
faultModel.doc: A named set of failure modes in an environment, with bounds on how many may occur at once. Claims are evaluated under a fault model.

scope.label: Scope
scope.doc: Limits failures of this scope. Omit to bound the listed modes (or all modes) regardless of scope.

source.label: Source
source.doc: The entity that justifies the value: a requirement or other claim, an assumption, an evidence entity, or an entity of any kind the specification declares. Required; a missing source is a validation error.

scenario.label: Scenario
scenario.doc: A specified sequence of input events and active faults executed over a set of behaviors.

faultModel.label: Fault model
faultModel.doc: The fault model this scenario's injected faults are drawn from.

assumption.label: Assumption
assumption.doc: A condition accepted by the model but not established by available evidence.

record.label: Record
record.doc: A kind of record the system stores: its owning component, key, fields and retention. The data rules (src/core/data-model.js) are computed over records and their copies.

owner.label: Owning component
owner.doc: The component whose state this record is: the authoritative table.

key.label: Key
key.doc: Names of the fields that identify a record. Each must be a declared field.

type.label: Type
type.doc: Free type text such as principal-id, display-name, number or timestamp. A type containing the word name or handle counts as a name.

personal.label: Personal-data class
personal.doc: Set when the field is personal data of a principal.

refersTo.label: Refers to
refersTo.doc: The record this field holds the key of, or "principal" for a principal id.

role.label: Role
role.doc: party: a principal taking part in the act (must refer to the principal by id); subject: the principal the record is about; snapshot: a copy of a value as it was at the time of the act.

retention.label: Retention
retention.doc: How long a record is kept and what ends it.

source.label: Source
source.doc: The entity that states this record (a requirement, decision or case).

copy.label: Copy
copy.doc: A place where some or all fields of one or more records are kept outside their owning component: a cache, a derived view, a CDN variant, a per-session store.

of.label: Copy of
of.doc: The record, or the records of a projection, that this copy holds fields of.

fields.label: Fields held
fields.doc: Field names of the source records, or record-id.field when ambiguous. Omitted: every field of every source record.

scope.label: Scope
scope.doc: shared: served as stored to more than one viewer (a CDN, a shared cache); per-session or per-principal: served only to one sign-in session or principal; internal: held server-side and never served as stored, every answer passing a read-time authority filter.

bound.label: Bound
bound.doc: How far an answer from this copy may trail its source: a number with a unit, or a text such as zero, K-62 or the read stamp.

point.label: Erasure point
point.doc: When a principal's deletion (or the end of the source record) has reached this copy.

basis.label: Basis
basis.doc: Why the copy is kept beyond a deletion, when it is (a legal obligation, a financial record).

dependsOnAuthority.label: Depends on authority
dependsOnAuthority.doc: True when the content of the copy depends on who is asking (grants, age band, privacy, blocks).

claim.label: Claim
claim.doc: A precise statement about a property expected to hold, with an explicit evaluation mechanism.

faultModel.label: Fault model
faultModel.doc: The fault model this claim is evaluated under. A result states it in its scope.

integrityRule.label: Integrity rule
integrityRule.doc: A consistency rule over the whole specification, in the rule language of src/core/integrity.js. Evaluated on every edit: a transaction that adds a violation of an error rule is refused. Proved or refuted in Lean by exegra prove-integrity.

severity.label: Severity
severity.doc: error: an edit may not add a violation; warning: violations are reported only.

rule.label: Rule
rule.doc: The formula, e.g. forall d : decision, forall x in d.closes, x.resolvedBy == d. Entity ids written as literals are not references: a rename does not rewrite them.

basis.label: Basis
basis.doc: The entities this rule rests on: decisions, requirements, claims.

evidence.label: Evidence
evidence.doc: An artifact supporting or contradicting a claim. Author-entered; never an evaluation result by itself.

supports.label: Supports the claim
supports.doc: Defaults to true. False marks contradicting evidence.

view.label: View
view.doc: A named projection of the model with explicit filter and display rules.

entityKinds.label: Entity kinds
entityKinds.doc: For the references projection: which kinds of entity to draw.

depth.label: Reference depth
depth.doc: For the references projection: how many reference hops around the focused entity to draw (1 to 3).

layout.label: Layout method
layout.doc: Presentation only. Default for this view; a viewer may choose another without changing the model.

reader.label: Reader
reader.doc: For the reader projection: the page, as blocks read top to bottom.

text.label: Text
text.doc: For a text block: the paragraph, in plain Markdown.

kind.label: Entity kind
kind.doc: For counts, table and list blocks: the kind of entity they read.

where.label: Where
where.doc: Conditions every entity shown must meet.

property.label: Counted property
property.doc: For a counts block: the property whose values are counted.

pattern.label: Pattern
pattern.doc: A case-insensitive regular expression tested against the text.

classify.label: Classify
classify.doc: Rules mapping a text property to a status value; the first matching pattern wins.

groupBy.label: Group by
groupBy.doc: A property, or a dotted path through references such as table.section.

status.label: Status
status.doc: Classify this column by the block's classify rules and show it as a status.

columns.label: Columns
columns.doc: For a table block; without columns the kind's first properties are shown.

titleProperty.label: Title property
titleProperty.doc: For a list block: the property shown as each item's title.

statusProperty.label: Status property
statusProperty.doc: For a list block: the property classified as each item's status.

facet.label: Facet
facet.doc: A property whose values become filter choices.

facetSeparator.label: Facet separator
facetSeparator.doc: Splits the facet text into several values, such as ", ".

hideWhenSet.label: Hide when set
hideWhenSet.doc: Entities with this property set are hidden until the reader asks to see them.

document.label: Document
document.doc: For a document block: the document id; without it, the first document.

ids.label: Entity ids
ids.doc: For a sections block: the sections or tables to show, in order.
